item.title: Very large pot hole out side The Cottage, Deerhurst Walton, 24th November
item.description:
Very large pot hole out side The Cottage, Deerhurst Walton, on the eastern edge of the carriageway, the failure of the road is approximately 1.5m by 5m in the worst position but the road has failed along the eastern edge over a good 10m. cars are bottoming out over the fault, even farm machinery has bottom out and scars on the road surface to testify to that. The Numerous HGV that use the lane daily violently shack the house if they hit the Failure at speed, the damage to property in the longer term is a concern. Vehicles are driving on to the grass verge to miss the failure and are increasingly getting closer to the property. This has been reported before but only the pothole within the failure has ever been look at. I would be grateful if Highway Engineer could make contact.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Deerhurst, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
